From the book

Words That
Stay With You.

A few lines from Half a Truth, Full of You — about love, memories, and the moments that change us.

Some people become memories. You became the reason I believe memories are beautiful.
The first day I saw you, I didn’t know your name, but somehow my heart remembered your smile. You never walked into my life loudly; you arrived like the first rain after a long summer—quiet, gentle and impossible to forget.
Love isn’t always two people loving each other. Sometimes one person gets the love… and someone else quietly carries the heartbreak. Maybe that’s how life keeps things balanced.

A little about me

Meet the author

I'm Abhinav Bhoopathi, an Indian author and working professional with a deep passion for storytelling. My writing explores love, relationships, emotions, and the experiences that shape us.

Half a Truth, Full of You is my third book, following Journey Through the Lines and Lessons Life Taught Me.
